_note: Seeded synthetic case history. Every case, date, officer action, signature count and name here is invented for the demo — no live government system was touched and no real person is described. The published CPGRAMS figures under "stats" are the one exception and are sourced below. Rows created from this file are flagged seeded=1 in the database so the product can say which is which.

cases.title: Road damage, Rajnagar Ward 4
cases.summary: A 40-metre stretch of broken surface after the first rain, with two earlier repairs in the same spot.
cases.reason: A village road inside a panchayat is panchayat work, not a state highway matter.

asks.q: Which stretch is worst near you?
asks.hint: A landmark is enough — the school turning, the handpump, the bus stop.
asks.ph: Example: the 40 m before the primary school gate

asks.q: Has this road caused you a loss or an injury?
asks.hint: A fall, a damaged vehicle, an ambulance or school van that could not pass.
asks.ph: Example: my scooter axle broke on 4 August

answers.a: The road outside our lane has broken up again. It floods every time it rains and children walk through it to school.
The 40 metres before the primary school gate
My scooter axle broke on 4 March

messages.text: This is the third time in two years. The last repair lasted six weeks.

cases.title: Burnt-out transformer, Kanjhawala feeder
cases.summary: Eleven streets without supply for nine days after the transformer failed.
cases.office: Executive Engineer, Tata Power Delhi Distribution
cases.reason: Distribution and metering sit with the licensee, not with the municipality.
cases.officer_atr: The matter was examined by the sub-divisional office. It is stated that the distribution transformer at the said location was attended to and load balancing carried out. The complaint is treated as redressed and closed at this end.

answers.a: The transformer burnt out on 2 May and eleven streets have had no power since.

messages.text: Supply came back on the 10th but it trips every evening around seven.

cases.title: Ration short of entitlement, Barkheda
cases.summary: Three kilos short every month against a card for five members, with no slip given.
cases.office: District Grievance Redressal Officer under the National Food Security Act
cases.reason: A short weight against a card is an entitlement failure, which the NFSA gives a named officer.
cases.officer_atr: The concerned Fair Price Shop dealer was issued a show-cause notice under the provisions of the Control Order. The dealer has submitted his reply. The matter stands closed at this level.

answers.a: The dealer gives us 22 kilos when the card says 25, and he does not give a receipt.
Barkheda village, Sehore district, Madhya Pradesh

messages.text: The dealer answered the notice but nothing changed. This month was 22 kilos again.

cases.title: Street lights out, NH-44 km 118 to 121
cases.summary: Three kilometres of highway lighting dead for two months at an accident-prone bend.
cases.reason: A national highway is NHAI work. A municipality cannot act on it even if it wanted to.
cases.officer_atr: With reference to the captioned grievance, the undersigned is directed to state that the concerned Junior Engineer has inspected the site and necessary rectification of the affected stretch has been carried out through the empanelled agency vide work order No. 4471/JE-II. The instant representation is accordingly treated as disposed of at this end.

answers.a: The street lights on the highway have been out for two months since the monsoon.
NH-44 km 119 service road entry, Durgapur

cases.title: Anganwadi kendra roof, Barkheda village
cases.summary: A collapsed roof section left thirty-two children sitting outside through the monsoon.
cases.reason: An anganwadi building is ICDS, which runs through the CDPO at block level.
cases.legal_basis: Article 243G and the Eleventh Schedule, entry 25

cases.title: Water supply failing four days a week
cases.summary: Nothing after 7 am on most days, with two households buying cans daily.
cases.reason: Piped supply inside a municipal area is the urban local body, under the Twelfth Schedule.

answers.a: Supply fails four days a week and there is nothing after seven in the morning.

cases.title: PF withdrawal pending since February
cases.summary: Claim filed in February, no movement and no reason recorded.
cases.reason: A provident fund claim is EPFO work and never a state department matter.
cases.legal_basis: Employees Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act 1952
cases.officer_atr: The claim of the member has been examined with reference to the records available. The member is advised to submit Form 10C duly attested along with the cancelled cheque leaf. Pending receipt, the grievance is treated as disposed of.

answers.a: My PF withdrawal has been pending since February and nobody will tell me why.

cases.title: Disputed debit of Rs 18,400
cases.summary: A card debit the account holder did not make, with no reply from the branch in three weeks.
cases.reason: A bank must be given the first chance to answer before the Ombudsman will take it.

answers.a: Rs 18,400 was debited from my account on 14 June and the bank has not replied.

cases.title: Income tax refund not received for AY 2025-26
cases.summary: Return processed in December, refund still not credited eight months later.
cases.office: Centralised Processing Centre, Income Tax Department
cases.reason: A refund is processed centrally at CPC, not by the local ward office.

cases.title: MGNREGA wages unpaid for 34 days of work
cases.summary: Work completed in April, muster roll signed, wages not credited.
cases.reason: Wage payment delay under MGNREGA is the Programme Officer, with a compensation clock.

cases.title: PM-KISAN instalment missing since the April cycle
cases.summary: Two instalments received, the third never arrived and the status page shows no reason.

cases.title: Possession delayed 26 months past the agreement date
cases.summary: Registered project, agreement date March 2024, no possession and no compensation offered.
cases.office: Uttar Pradesh Real Estate Regulatory Authority
cases.reason: A registered project is RERA. A consumer forum would be slower and weaker here.

cases.title: Refund not paid for a cancelled train
cases.summary: Train cancelled by the railway in May, TDR filed, refund not received.

cases.title: Billed for a plan that was never activated
cases.summary: Three months of charges for a broadband plan the connection never carried.

cases.title: RTI reply not given, 92 days past the limit
cases.summary: Application filed in April, no reply, no rejection, no reason.
cases.office: First Appellate Authority of the public authority concerned
cases.reason: A silent RTI is a first appeal, not a fresh grievance. The clock has already run.

cases.title: Payment demanded to release a mutation certificate
cases.summary: A sum demanded at the counter to move a file that has no fee.
cases.office: Chief Vigilance Officer of the department concerned
cases.reason: This is a vigilance matter, and it has no 21-day service clock — a different track entirely.
